title: The Ambush and the Magicians Bloodbath — Part 3

series.summary: A squad of armed applicants corners Hisoka in the fog, attempting to assassinate the magician before he strikes. Hisoka effortlessly slaughters them with razor-sharp cards, leaving Kurapika and Leorio frozen in terror when they witness the massacre.

segments.voiceover_text: Deep in the fog, a desperate ambush squad of armed applicants corners Hisoka. Brandishing swords and spears, they plot to assassinate the magician before he strikes.
Hisoka is not intimidated. Smiling with cold amusement, he draws a deck of playing cards and offers to play examiner to test their qualifications.
What follows is pure butchery. Moving faster than sight, Hisoka whips razor-sharp cards through the mist, slaughtering the entire squad in seconds.
Kurapika and Leorio stumble straight into the blood-soaked clearing. Freezing in horror, they find Hisoka standing among the corpses, his golden eyes locking onto them.
